analysis.reason: RSI 53.5에서 44.0으로 하락하며 약세 전환, MACD 히스토그램은 -0.1371에서 -2.1971로 악화 지속. 5일 평균 거래량 대비 0.31 수준으로 거래량 위축. 현재가 $366.02는 SMA200 $381.76 대비 -4.12% 하회, SMA50 $376.04 대비 -2.77% 하회. 볼린저밴드 하단 $353.45에 근접하며 하락 추세 강화.
analysis.reasonEn: RSI declined from 53.5 to 44.0, turning bearish. MACD histogram worsened from -0.1371 to -2.1971. Volume is subdued at 0.31x the 5-day average. Current price $366.02 is -4.12% below SMA200 ($381.76) and -2.77% below SMA50 ($376.04). Approaching the lower Bollinger Band at $353.45, reinforcing the downtrend.

[모멘텀 지표]

[거래량·결론]

analysis.narrativeEn:

· Position relative to SMA100 ($365.27)/SMA200 ($381.76): Above SMA100 but below SMA200, indicating weakening medium-to-long term trend.
· 52-week position (34.1%) + Current price range approaching historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (53.5→44.0): Decline within neutral zone, suggesting potential entry into oversold territory.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-0.1371→-2.1971): Continued worsening, reinforcing bearish trend.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near Lower Band $353.45): Approaching lower band, indicating potential for further decline.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($364.02): Near support based on SMA100.
· Swing Resistance ($366.50): Just above current price, acting as short-term resistance.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low pattern (Lower High): Continued weakening signal.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.31): Subdued volume, reducing trend reliability.
· Current phase diagnosis (Downtrend): Sell entry conditions met, wait for confirmation of bearish reversal before considering.
